style: Original gouache and ink advisors with neutral expressions and humorous occupational hats and props

advisors.name: property-tax
advisors.original_prompt:
Create ONE original city-management game advisor portrait, a gently comic editorial character illustration. Hand-painted gouache and clean ink contours, simplified sculptural face, expressive eyebrows and a slightly oversized head, subtle brush texture, polished storybook/European magazine illustration finish. NOT photographic, NOT a 3D render, NOT anime, NOT pixel art. Good-natured humor; competent and likeable rather than grotesque. Chest-up tight portrait in a vertical 4:5 composition; whole head and headwear entirely inside the frame with a little margin, head fills about 60% of the image, shoulders and one small occupational prop visible below the chin. Three-quarter view turned slightly toward the viewer, eyes engage viewer. Flat pale blue-grey background with very subtle vignette, opaque, no scene. Muted jewel colors, natural skin colors, clear silhouette, readable when reduced to a 64x82 game portrait. No words, lettering, numbers, emblems of real organizations, logos, signatures or framing borders. Original character, do not reproduce any existing SimCity advisor. Maintain this shared art direction as one cohesive series of eight portraits.
Subject: PROPERTY TAX advisor. A witty older woman with warm light-brown skin, a short silver bob, wonderfully arched eyebrows, tiny round spectacles low on her nose, a crooked moss-green accountant's eyeshade visor and a teal waistcoat over a cream shirt. She gives an amused knowing half-smile as though she has spotted a suspiciously generous deduction. One small brass-and-black pocket calculator held against her chest, only a few large blank keys, no text. Her visor and calculator immediately communicate municipal finances; no money shower or busy background.
advisors.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: the supplied single advisor portrait. Change the facial expression to completely neutral, composed and attentive. Relax both eyebrows and cheeks; lips gently closed in a level resting line, absolutely no upturned mouth corners, smile, smirk, grin or frown. Keep the exact character identity, age, skin color, face proportions, hair, headwear, clothing, occupational props, pose, framing, opaque blue-grey background and gouache-and-ink illustration style. Keep humorous character design only in the oversized hat and props, not in the expression. Simplify tiny brush marks and skin texture into broader painted shapes so this reads well as a small game portrait; not photographic. No text. Return one portrait.
